title: ISO
basic_theory: ISO controls how strongly the digital camera responds to available light. It is the digital equivalent of what was traditionally called film speed.
points: Low ISO usually gives a cleaner image.
High ISO helps in darker conditions or when a fast shutter is needed.
Very high ISO may introduce noise and reduce detail.
teaching_prompt: If there isn’t enough light for the aperture and shutter speed you want, ISO can help.
